parts:
Hi,

 

This is a continuation of my previous question.

 

Recap: I thought I had installed the development version but I was informed that the development version is:

 

 

library(devtools)

install_github("methylKit", username = "al2na",ref = "development",build_vignettes=FALSE)

 

After inputting the above commands, which did successfully load, I then attempt to read the files as before and got the message:

 

Error: could not find function "read"

 

Note: at a previous attempt, the files have read, but then I had issues with unite().

 

This time I have a problem at an earlier stage.  What could be the problem?

 

 

Michelle
